entries.source_audit: Smooth complete embedded E-minimizer; mean curvature vector points into Omega; sqrt(t)M foliates Omega. Unique in stated side/minimizing class. Do not replace with potentially singular arbitrary-cone current theorem.

normalization_notes: Smoczyk uses H=-X_perp. Multiply source positions by sqrt(2) to use H=-X_perp/2.
The supplied Angenent preprint has inconsistent scale/exponent displays. Use DLN2018 equation (5.2) and Section 3.3 for normalized ODE and metric; source pages were visually inspected.
ELS 2019 and 2020 PDFs are versions of the same work. Cite v3 2020 (31pp) with Theorem 5.7; v2 2019 (26pp) labels rigidity Theorem 5.6.
The survey explicitly does not identify Drugan-Nguyen variational torus with Angenent torus. Do not transfer its profile length bound to Angenent without qualification.
Only lambda=0 in Chang lambda-self-shrinker paper describes ordinary MCF shrinkers. No nonzero-lambda examples imported.
DLN birotational numerical S3/T3 proposals are not existence theorems; not included.
Compactness/properness/Type I statements for compact examples are direct geometric consequences of the stated smooth compact immersion and homothety.
Smooth compactness of self-shrinkers (CM,2012,CMH87,463-475,DOI10.4171/CMH/260) reviewed for context; its compactness theorem is not a new example and no additional entry was created.
Existing CM12 bibliographic entry may represent CatCM2012; parent may canonically reuse it after checking the edition. No implementation registry has been changed.
Supplied Graphical Theorem 2.4 has a visibly confirmed typo arccos(2b/pi); use the width relation cos(theta)=pi/(2b).
Graphical Theorem 11.1 prints nonnegative k_i together with a positive-definite apex Hessian; avoid reproducing its boundary case without a separate audit.
Supplied Notes gives the downward convention but writes the positive bowl-height asymptotic; upward formulas were checked against CSS original.
The Graphical preprint supplied is dated July 5, 2018; Notes is dated January 29, 2019. Keep locators tied to those editions.
Do not describe a translated bowl end as an ordinary fixed-radius asymptotically cylindrical end; its graph has quadratic-minus-logarithmic height growth.
No latest general classification or full source coverage is claimed.
For the Angenent–Velazquez neckpinch, |A|tip=|Hvec|tip/sqrt(n); Amax normalization gives translating speed sqrt(n).
